correctness.rationale: The Radau tableau yields the exact rational map (6+2z)/(6-4z+z²). All CTMC denominator eigenvalues are nonzero because its two poles have positive real part. Shortest directed paths and the exact Taylor coefficients prove the <=5-state local result and the negative fifth-distance entry on all longer cycles. For n=2..6, exact modular polynomial inversion yields complete nonnegative numerator certificates in n<=5; in n=6 only the coefficient of the fifth cyclic shift can change sign. Its quintic numerator is strictly increasing with a single positive root, and the diagonal coefficient is rigorously positive on [0,3] and [3,infinity) by separate polynomial inequalities. Fourier diagonalization proves eventual positivity on every directed cycle. The packaged checker independently reconstructs the identities, full matrices, mass conservation and rational root bracket with 158 deterministic assertions; this finite algebra supplements but does not replace the infinite-family arguments.

value.rationale: The exact dimension-five versus dimension-six boundary is not a textbook stability assertion: a standard third-order stiff integrator is positive at all timesteps on every directed cycle through five states but has no positive *small-step* positivity interval on the six-state cycle; positivity reappears at an explicit, uniquely isolated algebraic timestep. This exact system-size and timestep classification is a useful counterexample and boundary for CTMC and positivity-preserving ODE discretization.
